changes_made.explanation: Consolidated multiple variations of the same task name to 'Other:Narrative-driven Recommendation'. Normalized dataset names to consistent capitalization. Removed redundant output descriptions and normalized to more accurate terminology used throughout the paper.
Simplified metric variants to base forms as per guidelines. The paper uses both @k notation and specific instances (@5, @10), so normalized to @k which represents all variants used.
No LLMs are used as judges/evaluators in this paper. LLMs are used for generation and ranking, but not for post-generation evaluation or assessment.
The paper does not mention any human evaluation of generated outputs. All evaluations are conducted using automatic metrics.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on narrative-driven recommendation as an NLG task where systems generate ranked lists of recommendations based on narrative queries. Evaluation is exclusively automated using standard ranking metrics (Precision@k, Recall@k, NDCG@k). No human evaluation or LLM-as-judge methodologies are employed. The extraction was generally accurate but required normalization of dataset names and metric variants.
